real_defects.issue: A custom fee table with a gap (0-2, 6-20) parsed clean, so a carrier at 2 vehicles was told 'adding one vehicle moves the fee up $278.00' when no bracket covers 3 vehicles. parseFees now reports the uncovered range.
Vehicle counts went through Number(), so '0x10' became 16, '1e3' 1000 and '-0' passed the n < 0 check; counts now must be plain digits (spaces and underscores as separators still allowed).
The overlap error printed an open top bracket as '3-Infinity'; it now prints '3+'. The CSV export likewise wrote the open bracket as '1001-+'; it now writes '1001+'.

toCsv wrote registrant names as typed, so a name starting =, +, - or @ ran as a formula in Excel/Sheets (CSV injection, CWE-1236). csvCell now prefixes an apostrophe (numbers left alone). The same hole is in 203 other venture toCsv exporters; check_csv_formula_guard.py baselines them and fails on new ones (ratchet).

check_csv_formula_guard.py (added 2026-11-12) runs in no PR workflow yet. Fix: in the validate job add `python3 platform/ci/check_csv_formula_guard.py` and a `working-directory: platform/ci` step `python3 -m unittest test_check_csv_formula_guard`; add ventures/**/*.mjs to the paths filter if not already covered. Control plane: own PR, owner approval.
